notes: Ignore Roblox ErrorPrompt code 285 in Instant Disconnect recovery. Telemetry v2.2.1 filters 285 before writing an error event or shutting down the client; the PC watchdog also clears and ignores stale 285 events defensively. Normal PID/map/FPS monitoring remains active, so a real Roblox process exit still rejoins through the standard recovery path.
